news.title: Dustin May's stuff flashed, but the bullpen spoiled it
German Marquez to start Tuesday for Padres
Patrick Sandoval expected to start Thursday
Max Kepler drives in four runs Monday
Braydon Fisher placed on bereavement list
George Springer activated from family medical emergency list
Max Scherzer (back) to make rehab start Wednesday
